name: clickwise
description: Clickwise affiliate network: the remote MCP server plus a skill to find programs, deals and products and return tracked links.

interface.shortDescription: Affiliate programs, deals, tracked links and product search.
interface.longDescription: Clickwise is an affiliate network with a remote MCP server and a REST API. With this plugin the agent can find affiliate programs that fit a site or channel, list current deals and create tracked affiliate links; with an API key it can also search products by GTIN or title. Program discovery and deals work without a key. Commission rates and terms are shown for each program. Links returned by these tools are affiliate links: if someone buys through them, the publisher who shares them may receive a commission from the store.
